The People's Fighters Front has ramped up its operations in Sistan and Baluchistan, resulting in a rising number of casualties. In response, Iranian authorities are mobilizing the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps to combat these threats.

candidates.title: Burqa-clad, e-rickshaw clue: How cops tracked down model Shraddha Dubey
candidates.excerpt: Nagpur police used an e-rickshaw clue to track and arrest Shraddha Dubey and her associates. They fled from Uttar Pradesh and were located after a 24-hour surveillance operation. The operation was assisted by local intelligence and CCTV footage analysis. Shraddha claimed her innocence in a video but is suspected of involvement in a murder case. Police are examining circumstances surrounding the death of Shiva Sharma after the arrests.

candidates.title: 65-year old swimmer killed in shark attack off South African coast; 2 beaches shut
candidates.excerpt: Tragedy struck at Orient Beach in KuGompo City when 65-year-old open-water swimmer Janine Lochrenberg was fatally attacked by a shark. Despite the desperate efforts of fellow swimmers who rushed to assist her, she suffered life-threatening injuries to her arm and thigh, ultimately succumbing to her wounds. In response, local authorities promptly closed the beach and launched an investigation, as reports indicate a slight rise in shark attacks in recent years.

candidates.excerpt: The prime minister said Bhagwat spoke at length on a wide range of issues, including national progress and social unity, the need for self-reliance and to strengthen the character of society.

candidates.title: Amit Shah meets families of anti-drug campaigners killed in Punjab; targets AAP on open drug trade
candidates.excerpt: Amit Shah visited families of drug-related victims in Punjab, expressing condolences and discussing safety issues. He criticised the AAP government for its failure to tackle the drug menace effectively. Shah highlighted the dangers faced by those who oppose drug trafficking in the state. The recent murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota escalated political tensions in Punjab.

candidates.title: Trump’s tariff waiver on Russian oil: India gets relief for now, but is it credible?
candidates.excerpt: For India, the immediate relief is for its crude supply basket and exporters. If India decided to give up Russian crude oil, its single largest supplier would have gone off the table, with no easy replacement amid Middle East tensions. If it continued to buy Russian crude, then the 100% tariffs would have weighed on its exports to the US.
